Planned Features & Honest Feasibility Matrix

To adhere to the project principle of reliability and honest scope, here is the current engineering feasibility breakdown for requested roadmap items:

1. Visual Automation Builder

Feasible: Stored as lightweight JSON triggers on Supabase, pushed over Realtime WebSocket, and parsed on the ESP8266.

2. Energy-Saving Insights

Needs Sensor: Requires ACS712 or PZEM-004T current sensing before claiming kilowatt-hour percentage savings.

3. Offline Machine Learning

Feasible: Train logistic regression model offline on accumulated 360-byte hourly blobs to predict pre-warming schedules.
